# Prevent saved entries from losing their required details

## What & Why
The add flows now have regression coverage for incomplete submissions, but editing an existing answer or application should receive the same protection. This prevents a later form change from clearing a required title, company, or role and leaving a broken card behind.

## Done looks like
- Browser coverage confirms clearing an answer title or content cannot save and closes neither the dialog nor the existing entry
- Browser coverage confirms clearing an application's company or role cannot save and leaves the dialog open
- Existing valid entries remain unchanged after each rejected edit
